messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] RHIPE for CDH4
parts:
On Tue, Apr 23, 2013 at 3:44 AM, Vik Raguttahalli <vik....@gmail.com> wrote:

1) What is the time frame for the release of stable version of 0.73.1?

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/master/code/Rhipe_0.73.1.tar.gz
This is release.
 

2) Are there any significant changes in terms of features that will affect the performance between the the two versions? If not, is it best to evaluate  0.72 version with CDH3?


No, evaluate with 0.73.1. Since we develop of that, your bugs will be fixed quicker.

 

3) I was able to install and test 0.73.1 on CDH4. To get it to work, I had to create the file Protobuf-x86.conf under /etc/ld.so.conf.d/ and add the line /usr/local/lib to the file. Is this correct?


Does it work? Then it's correct. You can force protobuf to install in a different directory (if you''re doing from source, see ./configure and this will obviate the need
for custom ld.conf files)

Cheers
Saptarshi
